newsitem.title: FRANCE: Stability council not to make forex proposals - Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: Stability council not to make forex proposals - Arthuis.

text.p: An informal stability council to oversee economic policies inside the euro-zone after the launch of Europe's single currency would not issue specific instructions on currencies, French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Wednesday.
He said the council would be similar to the Group of Seven rich nations in that it would have an informal structure. But, he said, the comparison stopped there.

"I do not imagine that it would be making proposals on exchange rate levels," he told a news conference after meeting German Finance Minister Theo Waigel and the central bank heads of France and Germany.
And unlike the G7, the stability council would include only ministers and not central bank governors, Arthuis said.
He had been asked whether the stability council would be expected to give guidance on currencies in the way that the G7 currently does.
